intro: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at Kennesaw State University, working in the Sustainable Smart Systems Lab (S³ Lab) with my advisor, Bobin Deng. Before the Ph.D. I spent eight years at BJIT Ltd., moving from Software Engineer to Principal Software Engineer, building secure microservices, retrieval-augmented knowledge tools, and enterprise PLM integrations.
bio_short: Priyabrota Sen is a doctoral researcher in Computer Science at Kennesaw State University, working on computer vision, video world models, and the evaluation of learned systems under real operating conditions. Current work spans a vision-driven digital twin for robotic production lines, a benchmark for learned noise adaptation in quantum error-correction streams, and difficulty-ranked masking for video world models. Before starting the Ph.D. in 2025, Sen spent eight years at BJIT Ltd., rising from Software Engineer to Principal Software Engineer and delivering secure Java/Spring Boot services, retrieval-augmented knowledge tools, and Dassault Systèmes ENOVIA PLM/PDM integrations.
_about_note: The About section shows `bio_long` (keep it to a few short paragraphs). Set a flag below to true to also show the positioning line, the research-interest tags, or the headline numbers.
bio_long: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at [Kennesaw State University](https://www.kennesaw.edu/), advised by [Bobin Deng](https://ksuweb.kennesaw.edu/~bdeng2/) in the [Sustainable Smart Systems Lab (S³ Lab)](https://ksuweb.kennesaw.edu/~bdeng2/). My research is in computer vision and machine learning for systems that act in the physical world: vision-driven digital twins for robotic production lines, video world models, and the benchmarks and calibration needed to trust them.

Before the Ph.D. I spent eight years at [BJIT Ltd.](https://bjitgroup.com/), rising from Software Engineer to Principal Software Engineer, where I built secure Java/Spring Boot microservices, a retrieval-augmented knowledge tool, and Dassault Systèmes ENOVIA PLM integrations.

I received my B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from [Khulna University of Engineering & Technology](https://www.kuet.ac.bd/) (KUET), where I worked with [Prof. Muhammad Sheikh Sadi](https://kuet.ac.bd/cse/sadi) on error-correcting codes for memory reliability.
